publications.title: Deep learning enables fully automated cineCT-based assessment of regional right ventricular function
publications.subtitle: European Heart Heart Journal - Imaging Methods and Practice
publications.description: We developed and evaluated a fully automated pipeline consisting of two deep learning methods to automate volumetric and regional strain analysis of the RV from contrast-enhanced, ECG-gated cineCT images. The Right Heart Blood Segmenter (RHBS) is a 3D high resolution configuration of nnU-Net to define the endocardial boundary, while the Right Ventricular Wall Labeler (RVWL) is a 3D point cloud-based deep learning method to label the free and septal walls. We trained our models using a diverse cohort of patients with different RV phenotypes and tested in an independent cohort of patients with aortic stenosis undergoing TAVR.

5 to 20+ hours. Down to 5 minutes. That was our client's data workflow before and after they came to us. Go out to a lake. Collect water quality data. Clean the messy entries by hand. Build the Excel graphs. Upload everything to a map. So much manual cleaning that mistakes kept creeping in. We didn't tell them to use ChatGPT and call it a day. We rebuilt the entire system. Now they drag and drop their Excel files. The tool cleans the data, builds the graphs, updates the map. Done. They're non-technical. So the whole thing had to feel like nothing changed for them, except the 20 hours. This is what most people miss about AI in their business. It's not the chatbot. It's not the automated email. It's about combining the power of AI and software engineering to create systems that automate internal operations on the macro-scale scale. What's the one process in your business that's still eating hours every week? ...more

Input the tumor. Output the vaccine. Gamgee Technologies is building software that turns a dog’s tumor and healthy DNA into a personalized mRNA cancer vaccine design. Founder Paul Steven Conyngham spent 17 years in machine learning and had no biology background. When his dog Rosie was dying of cancer, he taught himself genomics, designed a vaccine around her tumor mutations, and coordinated the entire path from sequencing through manufacture and administration. Several of Rosie’s tumors shrank by 50-75%. Doing it by hand took a year and cost around $20,000. Gamgee’s target is a vaccine design in 48 hours at an end-to-end cost of $2,000. More than 300 dogs are already on the waitlist, and the company is preparing a clinician-led trial in 30 dogs to evaluate safety, immune response, and clinical outcomes. https://www.gamgee.io Congrats on the launch, Paul! 🚀 https://lnkd.in/gbmFc2Kj

A 49-year-old father lost his voice to a stroke. AI gave it back to him. Not a robotic imitation. His own voice, rebuilt. Last November, James lost his ability to speak. His kids missed his laugh. His wife missed hearing him say her name. Then Bland, an AI voice company, used just 5 seconds of old footage to recreate his voice with its new Speech v3 Human Speech Engine. His tone. His emotion. Even his laugh. The first thing James said was: “I got my voice back.” For business leaders, the significance goes far beyond an impressive AI demo. Voice is becoming the next major interface between people and AI. As speech models become more realistic, they could reshape customer service, healthcare, accessibility and sales. Bland says Speech v3 was trained on more than 100 million real human conversations and ranks 1st on Audio Realism benchmarks. But the benchmark isn’t the most important part. The real opportunity is building AI experiences that don’t just automate communication, but preserve the qualities that make communication feel human. Because as AI becomes more capable, trust, authenticity, and emotional connection may become the real differentiators. As voice AI becomes nearly indistinguishable from human speech, where’s the biggest opportunity to use it without losing the human connection? Video: Bland #AI #ConversationalAI #EnterpriseAI #ArtificialIntelligence #CustomerExperience #Technology

BREAKING: Bland Speech v3 by Bland debuts as the most human-sounding TTS model on our newest evaluation: Audio Realism Bench. Traditional speech benchmarks increasingly struggle to separate frontier systems that all sound clean, fluent, and intelligible. Audio Realism Bench instead asks a harder question: when two voices read the same transcript, which one sounds more like a real person? Vetted native speakers evaluate recordings blindly across phone agents, conversational assistants, and spoken explainers, judging the subtle qualities that define human-like speech. We also place real human recordings directly into the evaluation pool, testing whether evaluators can distinguish TTS models from actual human speech. Bland Speech v3 takes the top spot in our initial rankings, followed by MAI-Voice-2 by Microsoft AI and Grok TTS by SpaceXAI , all demonstrating important steps toward voice systems capable of sustaining genuinely human-feeling interactions. Thank you to the teams at Bland , Cartesia , OpenAI , smallest.ai , and SpaceXAI for aiding with initial integration. We're excited to see how this leaderboard continues to develop. See the full methodology here: https://lnkd.in/gTKt5Tp6 .
